name: Apple Design Resources
summary: Official Apple design resources: UI kits, icon templates, fonts, SF Symbols and product bezels for Apple platforms.
description: Apple's download hub for designers: Figma and Sketch UI kits, production templates and app icon templates for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS and visionOS, SF fonts (SF Pro, SF Compact, SF Mono, New York and script variants), the 7,000+ symbol SF Symbols library, Icon Composer and product bezels for marketing.
